name: outdoor-rain-partial-credit
description: GV-K4: the same plant on sandy soil with mulch (interval 5). 9 mm is a partial credit (at least half of 15 mm): on 06-05 it sets notBefore 06-06, so the window opens a day later.
why: Hand computation, example E3 (round(7 x 0.7 x 1.25 x 0.85) = 5, band 1 early and late) and the partial-credit rule (partial credit: notBefore = date + 1).
